title: pre-V6 NULL sender_msg_id breaks Message/get for old databases
description: row_to_message() now returns Err on NULL sender_msg_id (pre-V6 row or DB corruption). Before this commit, NULL fell back to using the message ID. Any user who ran kithd before V6 migration ran and somehow ended up with pre-V6 data will get hard errors on every Message/get or Message/query call — their entire message history becomes unreadable. Scenario: edge case where V4→V5 migration left NULL rows (schema_v4 backfills sender_msg_id=id but ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN can fail mid-migration leaving NULLs); V6 trigger only guards new inserts. Migration was UPDATE messages SET sender_msg_id = id; if this failed the rows remain NULL. Consequence: user files bug report about empty message list; debugging requires direct SQLite access.
